objective: Signed forward displacement from upright rest to settled rest, per compound lateral head swing. Count = maximum of 2 * planned pairs, observed roll strokes, observed yaw strokes. One directional excursion requires 10 degrees on that axis. Rebounds and startup included.
pass_criteria: All requested cycles complete, no physical floor/IK/joint/numerical stop, positive displacement, settled flat, startup-relative heading within 20 degrees after each completed cycle and at the final rest.
